# HICHEN Asian Market

Asian snacks stocked in a US warehouse and shipped in 1 business day. We specialize in spicy strips (mala latiao), chocolate bites, variety packs and bundles for chili lovers. The brand behind the site is HiChen (a US entity); the site name is HICHEN Asian Market.

## What we sell
- Spicy strips (mala latiao): chewy wheat strips in chili oil and Sichuan pepper, rated Heat 1 (mild) to Heat 5 (extra hot)
- Chocolate bites: planet cups, cocoa wafer rolls, coffee candy (no heat)
- Variety packs and bundles

## Learn (guides for spice lovers)
- What is latiao? https://www.uslatiao.com/learn-latiao.html
- Chinese heat levels explained (Heat 1–5, mala numbness) https://www.uslatiao.com/learn-heat.html
- Spicy snack buying guide https://www.uslatiao.com/learn-guide.html

## Key facts
- Ships from a US warehouse in 1 business day (orders before 2pm ET go out same business day)
- Free shipping over $35; flat $4.99 below
- Authentic Asian snacks, no ocean-freight wait
- Spice scale: Heat 1 (mild) to Heat 5 (extra hot); mala = chili heat + Sichuan-pepper numbness
- Most items are shelf-stable 6–9 months, no refrigeration
